panels.caption: THE NUCLEAR WAR DID NOT END WITH RUINS.
panels.narration: The Earth itself shattered.
panels.image_alt: Fractured landmasses suspended in a glowing magnetic field

panels.caption: CONTINENTS BECAME ISLANDS IN THE VOID.
panels.narration:
Turbulent magnetic waves held the fragments together.
Violent in motion. Predictable in their patterns.
panels.image_alt: Magnetic currents arc between the exposed undersides of floating islands

panels.caption: HUMANITY WAS ALMOST WIPED OUT.
panels.narration:
Those who survived learned to live
on the pieces of their old world.
panels.image_alt: A small human silhouette standing on a floating island

panels.caption: GENERATIONS PASSED IN THE MAGNETIC FIELDS.
panels.narration:
Humanity slowly evolved.
New attributes emerged in a changed world.
panels.image_alt: Three generations of survivors study a magnetic sensing instrument in their settlement

panels.caption: NUCLEAR MATERIALS FUSED INTO SOMETHING NEW.
panels.narration: A family of metals unlike anything from the old world.
panels.image_alt: Luminous Magneton ore embedded in fractured rock

panels.caption: THEY CALLED IT MAGNETON.
panels.narration:
What began as a discovery
became the foundation of civilization.
panels.image_alt: Two glowing green Type B Magneton cores of opposite polarity inside a precision motor

panels.caption: OPPOSITE POLARITIES. CONSTANT MOTION.
panels.narration:
Oppositely polarized Type B cores drove magnetic motors.
The motors powered a new age.
panels.image_alt: A floating city built above a glowing Magneton engine

panels.caption: THE ENGINES DID MORE THAN KEEP THE LIGHTS ON.
panels.narration:
They stabilized the islands and generated
a field that restored the feel of the old gravity.
panels.image_alt: People stand upright inside a city gravity-control chamber while fragments float outside

panels.caption: CITIES ROSE ABOVE THE BROKEN EARTH.
panels.narration:
Magneton kept them afloat.
Every city depended on its supply.
panels.image_alt: A market street powered by green conduits beneath the floating city’s towers

panels.caption: THE FIRST BARONS WERE MINERS.
panels.narration:
They extracted Magneton and built ships from it.
Magnetic motors carried them between the islands.
panels.image_alt: A squat Mole mining ship with an ore cassette, drill, and magnetic engines

panels.caption: TRADE ROUTES LED TO CITIES. MINING ROUTES LED TO POWER.
panels.narration:
Those who controlled the mines and the fleets
became the new ruling class.
panels.image_alt: Ore is unloaded at a mining dock as a proprietor oversees trade

panels.caption: THE CITIES GATHERED INTO DUCHIES.
panels.narration:
Civilization returned to feudal rule.
Its foundations were no longer land alone, but Magneton.
panels.image_alt: Mining barons gather in a council chamber overlooking floating cities

panels.caption: VEYMARCH. A DUKE IN NAME.
panels.narration: Duke Rovan Vey overlooks the small city his fleet can barely afford to protect.
panels.image_alt: Rovan and his general look over a small island city with battered ships. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: THE COST OF KEEPING THE ROUTES OPEN.
panels.narration: General Grievous: “The soldiers’ pay is overdue. The repair yards are waiting too.”
panels.image_alt: General Grievous presents the fleet accounts and an almost empty pay chest. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: OTHER DUKES GREW RICH. HIS FLEET GREW SMALLER.
panels.narration: Rovan: “We bled keeping pirates from their mining ships. They traded. They grew. And now I cannot pay the soldiers who made it possible.”
panels.image_alt: Duke Rovan Vey turns toward a wealthy Caravan with a decision taking shape. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: A CARAVAN FROM THE NEARBY DUCHY OF AURIC REACH.
panels.narration: Armoured soldiers board the trading ship. Charged Tesla guns hold the unarmed sailors at a standstill.
panels.image_alt: Bronze-armoured soldiers board a twin-hull Caravan and aim Tesla guns at unarmed sailors. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: THE DUKE PRESENTS HIS CLAIM.
panels.narration: Rovan: “I seize this vessel of Auric Reach against the unpaid protection fees owed to my soldiers.”
panels.image_alt: Rovan announces the seizure to the merchant captain while his soldiers guard the sailors. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: THE SOLDIERS ANSWER WITH A CHEER.
panels.narration: The cheers roll across the deck. The sailors remain silent. Grievous watches both sides.
panels.image_alt: Soldiers cheer with their Tesla guns raised safely while the civilian crew stands silent. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: ROVAN WILL NO LONGER WAIT FOR ANOTHER DUKE’S PERMISSION.
panels.narration: Rovan: “I will define my own future. We sail for Auric Reach. I will take what is mine.”
panels.image_alt: Rovan declares his own future at the seized Caravan’s chart table. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: THE SEIZED RESOURCES BECOME PAY, EQUIPMENT, AND NEW RECRUITS.
panels.narration: His veterans are exceptionally well trained. Now they put that experience into drilling the new soldiers.
panels.image_alt: Bronze-armoured veterans train new recruits equipped from seized resources. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: ONE CAPITAL SHIP. A SMALL FLEET. AN ARMY WITH PURPOSE.
panels.narration: Rovan takes his army toward Auric Reach. His fleet has only one capital ship: a Bastion.
panels.image_alt: A single Bastion capital ship departs with the seized merchant Caravan nearby

panels.caption: THE FIRST WAR BETWEEN DUCHIES SINCE THE FRACTURE.
panels.narration: They have fought pirates. They have never faced an organised invasion. Rovan strikes at one of Auric Reach’s barons.
panels.image_alt: Rovan’s trained bronze-armoured troops surprise an Auric Reach baron’s docks. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: THE DOCKS FALL. THE SHIPS ARE SEIZED.
panels.narration: His veterans move with a discipline the defenders cannot match. The baron loses control of the harbour.
panels.image_alt: Veteran troops secure captured merchant airships at the baron’s harbour. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: THEN THE CITY FALLS WITH SURPRISING EASE.
panels.narration: Superior training gives Rovan his victory. The captured city and ships become the foundation of his growing power.
panels.image_alt: Rovan receives the surrender of the captured city alongside disciplined troops. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

pages.Title: The Five Take the City

panels.caption: FIVE SUITS. FIVE DIFFERENT WEAPONS.
panels.narration: Rovan works the stolen Type C in secret. The intricate silver flows into continuous armour, without joints or gaps. There is no material for a sixth set.
panels.image_alt: Rovan privately crafts intricate seamless silver Type C armour and the captains’ five different weapon loadouts.

panels.caption: THE FIVE CAPTAINS OF THE SILVER GUARD.
panels.narration: A lance. A broadsword. Twin swords. A war hammer. A scythe. Each captain wears sealed, weapon-impervious Type C armour; crimson cloth rests over the silver.
panels.image_alt: Exactly five captains in intricate, fully sealed silver armour with crimson capes; their weapons are a lance, broadsword, twin swords, war hammer and scythe.

panels.caption: THE FLEET STRIKES ANOTHER SMALL CITY IN AURIC REACH.
panels.narration: Rovan’s single capital ship leads the assault. The lance captain condenses magnetic fields at the weapon’s tip and fires them like a cannon, breaking the town guard’s position.
panels.image_alt: A silver captain fires a magnetic condenser lance at a fortified town-guard emplacement as Rovan’s one capital ship and smaller vessels attack the floating city.

panels.caption: THE BROADSWORD OPENS THE HARBOUR.
panels.narration: Condensed fields make the blade immense. It cuts through a defending ship’s hull, opening a way for Rovan’s soldiers to board while the town guard falls back.
panels.image_alt: A seamless silver knight enlarges an ornate broadsword with condensed magnetic fields and cuts a defending ship’s bronze hull as infantry fight for the docks.

panels.caption: ABOVE THE STREETS, THE TWIN BLADES RIDE THE WIND.
panels.narration: Their captain flies like a bird over the town guard, striking from above as bronze-armoured soldiers push through the streets below.
panels.image_alt: A silver captain flies above the town guard with one curved wind sword in each hand, trailing magnetic currents over the occupied streets.

panels.caption: THE HAMMER FALLS. A SHIELD RISES.
panels.narration: The captain slams the war hammer into the paving. Its own magnetic field shields the advancing soldiers from the town guard’s Tesla guns.
panels.image_alt: A seamless silver captain strikes the street with a war hammer, raising a magnetic dome that shields crimson-clad troops from the town guard’s green Tesla fire.

panels.caption: TWO CONCENTRATED POINTS. ONE FINAL LEAP.
panels.narration: The scythe captain jumps between two points of magnetic energy into the command terrace. With the docks breached and the streets lost, the town guard lays down its guns. Rovan’s soldiers seize the city.
panels.image_alt: A silver scythe captain jumps between two concentrated magnetic nodes into the command terrace while the town guard surrenders and Veymarch soldiers take control.

pages.footer: PROLOGUE · THE FIVE TAKE THE CITY

panels.caption: IN THE CAPTURED CITY, ROVAN MEETS HIS GENERAL.
panels.narration:
Grievous: “We have taken a city. Now we have to hold it.”
Rovan: “Repair the seized ships. Train the recruits. We decide what comes next.”
panels.image_alt: Rovan and General Grievous plan their next steps, with crimson-clad Veymarch soldiers at the captured city’s command room

panels.caption: MEANWHILE, IN AURIC REACH.
panels.narration: The ruler of Auric Reach: “Dispatch three capital ships. Set course for Rovan.”
panels.image_alt: The unnamed ruler of Auric Reach orders three capital ships toward Rovan beneath the gold banner

panels.caption: THREE CAPITAL SHIPS DEPART.
panels.narration: Gold standards rise above three armoured hulls. While Rovan makes his plans, Auric Reach’s ships are already on their way.
panels.image_alt: Exactly three Auric Reach capital ships depart together under gold and navy standards, heading toward Rovan
